instructions: Resolve only the 19 disagreements shown on the generated adjudication boards. Preserve concept and specificity. Do not edit verified-matches.json from this file without maintainer acceptance.

entries.note: Solar shows a generic standing person inside a circular enclosure, while Lucide shows a wheelchair user without an enclosure; both signal accessibility but the subject and containment differ.
Solar keeps the check fully enclosed by a complete circle, which Lucide circle-check preserves; circle-check-big instead uses an open ring and an oversized check that crosses it.
Both depict an adhesive bandage, but Solar crosses two padded strips into an X while Lucide bandage shows one horizontal strip, so the object matches with a meaningful drawing difference.
Solar is a handled briefcase with a flap and centered front clasp, matching Lucide briefcase-business; the existing divided briefcase lacks that flap-and-clasp structure.
Solar is an exclamation mark enclosed by a rounded warning triangle, and Lucide triangle-alert preserves both the warning modifier and the enclosing shape.
Solar depicts a floppy disk with its label slot and lower inset, and Lucide save preserves the same floppy-disk pictogram despite using an action name.
Solar is three equal horizontal menu lines, which Lucide menu reproduces; the existing hamburger is a food pictogram rather than a navigation control.
Solar shows an open shackle over an undecorated lock body, matching Lucide lock-open without adding a keyhole or other modifier.
Solar is a simple standalone magnifying glass, and Lucide search preserves the same circular lens and angled handle without an added modifier.
Solar depicts a pair of in-ear earbuds, while the inspected Lucide headphones and headset are over-ear or head-mounted; no Lucide icon preserves the in-ear pair.
Solar combines an alarm clock with a centered minus modifier, which Lucide alarm-clock-minus preserves; the existing alarm-clock changes that state to clock hands.
The bookmark shape matches, but Solar places it inside a complete circular enclosure that Lucide bookmark omits, making the reference a meaningful variant.
Solar combines a smiling face with four scan corners, and Lucide scan-face preserves both the face and the framing; the existing scan omits the face.

Solar combines a gamepad with a charging cable or connector extending below it; the inspected Lucide gamepad variants omit that charging modifier, and separate battery or charger icons are not equivalent composites.
Solar is a circular 10-second media control with an explicit numeral, while the inspected Lucide rewind, skip, refresh, and rotate families omit the 10-second specificity.

Solar combines a server block with a cloud at the lower right; the inspected Lucide server and monitor-cloud icons split those cues by changing the object or omitting the server, so neither preserves the composite meaning.
Solar is a shield with a centered X modifier, and Lucide shield-x preserves both the shield enclosure and the cross; the existing shield drops the modifier.
Both show a steaming handled hot-drink cup without a tea-specific modifier, so Lucide coffee preserves the same object and specificity despite the vocabulary difference.
Solar places the underlined U inside a rounded-square control, while Lucide underline preserves the letter and underline but omits that enclosing control.
